source_title: Stripe Acquires Payment Processing Startup Lemon Squeezy

snippets.snippet_text: "As a merchant of record, Lemon Squeezy calculates and pays global sales tax for digital products, handling legal processing and fees in every country. It primarily serves SaaS and software businesses."
